title: 第一卷第19章 离开青阳第一卷第20章 路遇截杀
content_zh:
;;
姬音澜赠剑，释放出的信号，非同小可。
心中正想着在前往都城途中亲自截杀君无邪的契长老，眼神阴沉无比。
他知道自己不能亲自出手了，否则后果严重。
萧家众元老与高层，更是悔得肠子都青了，一股绝望笼罩心头。
“恭喜无邪小友！”
“小友即将成为大河剑宗内门弟子，那日后便是人中之龙啊。”
……
几大家族等高层纷纷上前祝贺，笑容那叫一个灿烂，宛若众星拱月般将君无邪拱卫在中间。
“至今日起，凡是遇到萧家之人，杀无赦！”
毕家家主当场表态。
“萧家拿走的矿脉与产业，必须双倍割让回来！”
吉家家主表态。
“往后，只要与我江家有商业来往的，皆不许与萧家有任何商业合作！”
江家家主表态。
“唔，萧家之人，往后若胆敢触犯律法，不论轻重，就地格杀！”
城主下达了命令。
一时间，萧家众人脸色惨白如纸，从前些时日的不可一世，变成了过街老鼠，人人喊打。
完了，萧家完了！
众元老差点昏死过去。

众人一片嘘声。
前些日子，萧家多么的高调，多么的强势啊。
城内各家族，各商铺深受欺压，敢怒不敢言。
如今萧家落到这个境况，自作自受，甚至没有人同情，都露出幸灾乐祸的表情。
……
“月瑶，你会不会觉得哥哥太残忍了。”
离开英才选拔赛场，君无邪抱着月瑶，轻声问道。
“不是呀，在月瑶心里，无邪哥哥永远都是最好的。”
“真的吗？”
君无邪本来有些担心，听到她这么说，心里暗自松了口气，笑着刮了刮她的小鼻子。
小月瑶眨巴着眼睛，咬着手指说道：“嗯～在这个世上，月瑶只有无邪哥哥。所以呀，无邪哥哥是月瑶的全世界哦～”
“小傻瓜，你也是哥哥的全世界。”
君无邪心都化了，宠溺地揉了揉她的小脑袋，在她银铃般的笑声中出了城，登上一片山地。
这里有坟墓，孤零零的，坟头长满了草。
君无邪在墓前静静伫立。
“萧叔叔，无邪哥哥和月瑶来看你啦。”小月瑶抹了抹眼泪，随即又笑了起来，道：“无邪哥哥都好了，他可厉害啦，还认识了一位好漂亮好漂亮的公主姐姐～”
“父亲，我来了。”君无邪坐在墓前，背靠墓碑，轻声道：“我今天断绝了与萧家的关系，您九泉之下会怪我吗？”
“半年前，他们害死了您，父仇不共戴天，我无论如何也不能再做萧家人。”
“你的无邪要走了，离开青阳城，这一去，往后可能回来看您的时间会很少。您走得太突然，我还有好多话想问您呢，我的母亲是谁，她在哪里……”
“记得小时候，我要骑马，您怕我摔着，让我骑在您背上，把您当做马……可现在我没父亲了……”
content_en:
;;
Ji Yinlan gave the sword as a gift, and the signal it sent out was extraordinary.
He was thinking about Elder Qi who personally intercepted and killed Jun Wuxie on the way to the capital, his eyes were extremely gloomy.
He knew that he could not take action personally, otherwise the consequences would be serious.
The elders and senior officials of the Xiao family were so regretful that their intestines turned green, and a sense of despair enveloped their hearts.
"Congratulations to my innocent little friend!"
"My little friend is about to become an inner disciple of Dahe Sword Sect, and he will be a dragon among men in the future."
…
Several big families and other high-level officials came forward to congratulate him. Their smiles were so bright that they were like stars over the moon, guarding Jun Wuxie in the middle.
"From today on, anyone who meets the Xiao family will be killed without mercy!"
The head of the Bi family expressed his position on the spot.
"The mineral veins and industries taken away by the Xiao family must be ceded back in double the amount!"
The head of the Ji family expressed his stance.
"From now on, anyone who has business dealings with my Jiang family will not be allowed to have any business cooperation with the Xiao family!"
The head of the Jiang family expressed his stance.
"Well, if anyone from the Xiao family dares to violate the law in the future, no matter how serious it is, they will be killed on the spot!"
The city lord issued the order.
For a moment, the faces of everyone in the Xiao family were as pale as paper. They had been so arrogant in the past few days and turned into rats crossing the street. Everyone was shouting to beat them.
It’s over, the Xiao family is over!
The elders almost fainted.
Everyone booed.
A few days ago, the Xiao family was so high-profile and powerful.
All the families and shops in the city were deeply oppressed and they dared not speak out.
Now that the Xiao family is in this situation, they have brought it upon themselves, and no one even sympathizes with them, they all show expressions of gloating about their misfortune.
…
"Yue Yao, do you think my brother is too cruel?"
After leaving the talent selection arena, Jun Wuxie hugged Yueyao and asked softly.
"No, in Yueyao's heart, brother Wuxie will always be the best."
"Really?"
Jun Wuxie was a little worried at first, but when he heard what she said, he secretly breathed a sigh of relief and scratched her little nose with a smile.
Xiao Yueyao blinked her eyes, bit her fingers and said, "Well~ In this world, Yueyao only has brother Wuxie. So, brother Wuxie is Yueyao's whole world~"
"Little fool, you are also my brother's whole world."
Jun Wuxie's heart melted, he rubbed her little head lovingly, and with her silvery laughter, he left the city and climbed into a mountainous area.
There is a grave here, alone, and the grave is covered with grass.
Jun Wuxie stood quietly in front of the tomb.
"Uncle Xiao, Brother Wuxie and Yueyao are here to see you." Xiao Yueyao wiped her tears, then laughed again and said, "Brother Wuxie is fine. He is amazing. He also met a very beautiful princess~"
"Father, I'm here." Jun Wuxie sat in front of the tomb, leaning against the tombstone, and said softly: "I severed my relationship with the Xiao family today, will you blame me?"
"They killed you half a year ago. Father's hatred is irreconcilable. I can no longer be part of the Xiao family no matter what."
"Your innocence is leaving Qingyang City. After this trip, you may have very little time to come back to see you. You left so suddenly. I still have many things to ask you. Who is my mother and where is she..."
"I remember when I was young, I wanted to ride a horse, but you were afraid that I would fall, so you asked me to ride on your back, treating you like a horse... But now I don't have a father..."
